events.note: First lightship moored at the lower end of the Saint-Roch traverse (Cloutier gives 1830; Lighthouse Friends says the schooner Brilliant was anchored in 1831)
An iron lightship, found unsuited to Halifax Harbour, moored here
The lightship was run down and sunk by the ship Loyal on 16 October; raised and back on station 8 July 1888
A lighthouse on a pier replaced the lightship (the pier failed and the station was abandoned in 1907)
A new steel, self-propelled lightship placed on the station
On the Light List for 1939; by the 1940 edition only a buoy marks the place

events.note: Lightship placed on station in February (Archives Canada's record says circa 1906); the vessel built 1903 as Lurcher, later No. 14
The last lightship of Canada left the station; an automatic buoy replaced her (Cloutier says the last, No. 4, arrived here in 1964)
